- Inline：内置策略。
description.en:
The type of the policy. Valid values:

- System: system policy.

- Inline: inline policy.

title.zh: 为访问配置移除权限策略

descriptions.zh:
内置策略移除后不可恢复。

本文将提供一个示例，为访问配置`ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****`移除一条系统策略`AliyunECSFullAccess`。
descriptions.en:
After you remove an inline policy from an access configuration, the policy cannot be restored.

This topic provides an example on how to remove the system policy `AliyunECSFullAccess` from the access configuration `ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso remove-permission-policy-from-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --permission-policy-type System --permission-policy-name AliyunECSFullAccess --region cn-hangzhou
